title: Debug: Div Soup to Semantics
prompt:
This page works, but it's meaningless to assistive tech: everything is `div`s. Restructure it: the first `div` becomes a `header`, the second a `nav`, the third `main`, and the last a `footer`. Keep every piece of text exactly where it is.

Rules:
- Exactly those four semantic elements, same order.
- All text content unchanged.
- No `div`s remain.
boilerplate:
PetitFour

Menu Order

Small cakes, big joy

Baked fresh every morning.

12 Rue des Lilas, Paris

tests.name: all four landmarks in order
tests.hint: Replace the four divs, top to bottom: header, nav, main, footer.

tests.name: text content untouched
tests.hint: This is a swap-the-wrapper exercise: the inner content stays identical.

tests.name: no divs remain
tests.hint: All four divs get replaced — none should survive.
